name: Skills page renders seeded skills and links to the Test Quality Reviewer agent
description: L02 (skills). Loads /skills, confirms the seeded skill 'uncovered-branches' is listed, selects it and confirms its Config tab renders. Then loads /agents, opens the seeded 'Test Quality Reviewer' agent card, switches to its Skills tab, and confirms the three seeded skills (uncovered-branches, corner-cases, mock-overuse) linked in seed.ts are listed there. Read-only: no create/import/delete/drag-and-drop.
